from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document regarding the case and administrative acts."""
    document_id: str = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    case_nature: str = Field(description="The broad nature of the case, e.g., 'Civil', 'Administrative', 'Criminal'")
    administrative_act_type: str = Field(description="The specific type of administrative act involved, e.g., 'Administrative Punishment', 'Administrative Confirmation', 'Administrative Compulsion'")
    punitive_measures: list[str] = Field(description="Specific punitive measures or penalties mentioned (e.g., 'Fine', 'Detention', 'Confiscation'), empty list if none")
    administrative_body: str = Field(description="The government agency or entity performing the administrative act")
    legal_basis: str = Field(description="The laws or regulations cited as the basis for the administrative act")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[DocumentCaseInfo]
